methods.label: Find the quotient from multiplication
methods.explanation: The greatest common factor of 8 and 12 is 4. To calculate the quotient, use the multiplication fact \(4\times2=8\); therefore \(8\div4=2\).
methods.levelReason: The added reasoning uses only Grade 2 inverse multiplication facts; the preserved greatest-common-factor statement is within Grade 5.
